runs.label: original-ui
runs.classification: detected automatic redisplay after access restoration

runs.label: corrected-ui
runs.classification: passed complete API and browser proof

scope: Recover original Board query preparation and accepted submission after unavailable replies
assertions: Proxy forwards an actual successful preparation and replaces its reply with Unavailable
Proxy forwards an actual accepted submission and replaces its receipt with Unavailable
Recovery sends byte-identical original requests; accepted submission returns byte-identical receipt
Settlement includes both receipt attempts and observation inside its original 60-second bound; upload retains the original 120-second outer bound
Original UI fails the zero-cleared-result assertion; corrected UI resumes only on explicit selection without another submission
limits: The first UI-negative run and corrected run differ in fixture cleanup nesting, which runs after the tested assertion; their exact source hashes are retained.
This is a focused development proof, not all-source clean or hosted qualification.
Unavailable replies do not establish rejected admission or explain shared-host storage delays.
